name: On The Last Episode
source:
The silliest host of a gameshow (where contestants kill each other for prize money) interviews the first season's winner, who's a little stuck on the past... so let's dive into that backstory for the fans and give them a good recap of the debut season and all the regrets that come with it!

[from [url=https://voidpineapple.itch.io/on-the-last-episode]itch.io[/url]]
